--- PAGE 1 ---
Stability of approximate quantum broadcasting
Results and limits of a finite research campaign
ASTRA ULTRA campaign∗
9 October 2026
Abstract
The campaign did not establish a historic-scale breakthrough. Its strongest internally
checked results concern approximate quantum broadcasting. First, a deduction from Kitaev’s
approximate factorization theorem gives a dimension-independent, linear bound on the distance
of a self-compatible, nearly idempotent channel to an entanglement-breaking channel. An ex-
plicit antisymmetric example proves that a weaker, unentangled-input hypothesis cannot replace
thecompletenorm. Second, reconstructionofanarchivedpure-stateargument, apairwisecoher-
ence estimate, and a second-order Gram-matrix measurement construction improve its reported
fourth-root modulus to a linear modulus. An elementary lower example shows that the linear
order cannot be improved uniformly. Complete deductions, assumptions, resource boundaries,
and unresolved novelty questions are recorded below. Neither result establishes a new physical
phenomenon or a dimension-independent computational capability.
1 Status and provenance
The mathematical scope is finite-dimensional complex quantum systems. A channel is completely
positive and trace preserving (CPTP). State distance is
T (ρ,σ ) = 1
2∥ρ−σ∥1.
Channel distance below is thefull diamond norm, without a factor of one half. An entanglement-
breaking (EB) channel has a measure-and-prepare realization. “Internally checked” means a written
derivation was reconstructed and challenged by another model investigator. It does not mean proof-
assistant certification, external expert review, or verified historical priority.
Two immutable repositories were consulted selectively:
• Astra: 7a841813b40ffeb45addeba5969e323a71cbeab5.
• OpenAI Math: fd4aeeb2ee4fc729c18d98444fed42fd0529eeeb.
Astra’s 00_START_HERE.txt was the initial entrypoint. The pure-state argument reconstructs card
N407 and its exact underlying proof (SHA-256 beginning984acfe2c372). Its archived status was
unreviewed; no repository assertion was promoted merely by retrieval. The channel factorization
result below is imported from the specific primary preprint [1]; its 48-page proof was not indepen-
dently rebuilt in full during this campaign. This dependency is explicit throughout.
